verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents that Triggers and SLOs can route notifications to a custom webhook, delivering a JSON payload on alert firing, which is exactly the mechanism needed to trigger automated remediation scripts or agents (honeycomb-docs-8, honeycomb-docs-18). This is a first-party, generally-applicable capability rather than an AI-specific feature. Missing for 10: a concrete worked example of wiring a webhook to an agent/remediation pipeline, and independent/community corroboration of this specific use case.
